$description: Measured drift counts. check.mjs fails when a count grows, and X1 fails when a number here sits above what the last logged run measured. Lower a number only together with the change that earned it, and the run that measured it is in runs.log. Reasoning belongs in decisions.md; what these numbers mean belongs in outcomes.md.
$recalibrated_because: The numbers this file carried were measured on the portfolio monorepo, where the surfaces that consume these tokens live. This package is the extraction, so every count was re-measured against the tree that actually ships (D-53). Two moved for real reasons rather than for want of scope: S2 rose because the scale clauses now scan components/ame, which they never did in the monorepo; H1 rose because most of this system's consumers stayed behind.
